mapper.select: SELECT id, actor_user_id, request_id, operation_code, request_hash, resource_type, resource_id, result_json, created_at FROM trading_operation_record WHERE actor_user_id=#{actor} AND request_id=#{requestId}
SELECT request_id FROM trading_operation_record WHERE actor_user_id=#{actor} AND operation_code=#{operation} AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(result_json,'$.evidenceDigest'))=#{digest} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO trading_operation_record(id, actor_user_id, request_id, operation_code, request_hash, resource_type, resource_id, result_json, created_at) VALUES (#{row.id}, #{row.actorUserId}, #{row.requestId}, #{row.operationCode}, #{row.requestHash}, #{row.resourceType}, #{row.resourceId}, #{row.resultJson}, #{row.createdAt})
